description: Judge vetting on the iGPU laptop (Intel Arc): the laptop profile's 3B contestants, but the judge runs on the laptop itself instead of borrowing the ProDesk. The judge is llama3.1:8b (bigger than both contestants) with NO num_ctx set, so the judge transcript auto-sizer (8192 / 16384 / skip) is the behavior under test; run judge_context_audit.py over the results afterwards to see which window each duel needed. The scenario set exercises each judge path: a plain debate, two code duels whose run reports the judge must weigh, a code game, the 40-turn game whose own scenario judge the profile judge overrides, and a 20-turn long-form story for the largest transcripts. Pull the judge first: ollama pull llama3.1:8b.
